ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest / UNC3944) help-desk takeover — admin-driven MFA/credential reset followed by sign-in from new ASN within 4h
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider initial-access chain: vishing the IT help desk into resetting MFA or the password of a privileged user, the adversary then registers their own factor and signs in (often from a residential-proxy / VPN ASN) within minutes. Correlates the directory-side reset to the very next interactive success on the same UPN.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as resetTime values(All_Changes.command) as resetAction from datamodel=Change.Account_Management where All_Changes.action=updated AND (All_Changes.command="*authentication*method*" OR All_Changes.command="*password*reset*" OR All_Changes.command="*MFA*" OR All_Changes.command="*security*info*") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.src_user | rename All_Changes.user as user All_Changes.src_user as admin | where admin!=user AND isnotnull(admin) | join type=inner user [| tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as signinTime values(Authentication.src) as src values(Authentication.app) as app values(Authentication.user_agent) as ua from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND Authentication.signature_id!="" by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as user] | eval delaySec=signinTime-resetTime | where delaySec>=0 AND delaySec<=14400 | iplocation src | stats min(resetTime) as resetTime min(signinTime) as signinTime values(resetAction) as resetAction values(src) as src values(Country) as country values(app) as app values(ua) as ua by admin user delaySec | convert ctime(resetTime) ctime(signinTime) | sort - signinTime
ucs.kql:
let WindowHours = 4h;
let MfaResets = CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where Application == "Office 365"
| where ActionType has_any ("Reset user password", "Update user", "Set force change user password", "Update authentication methods", "User registered security info", "Admin registered security info", "Update StsRefreshTokenValidFrom Timestamp")
| mv-expand Target = ActivityObjects
| extend TargetUpn = tostring(Target.Name)
| where TargetUpn matches regex @"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$"
| extend Admin = AccountDisplayName
| where isnotempty(Admin) and tolower(TargetUpn) != tolower(Admin)
| project ResetTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn = tolower(TargetUpn), Admin, AdminIP = IPAddress, ResetAction = ActionType;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend LowerUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner MfaResets on $left.LowerUpn == $right.TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowHours)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime = Timestamp, DelaySec, TargetUpn, Admin, AdminIP, SignInIP = IPAddress, Country, City, Application, UserAgent, ResetAction
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowHours = 4h;
let MfaResets = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Category in ("UserManagement", "AuthenticationMethod")
| where OperationName has_any ("Update user", "Reset user password", "Reset password (by admin)", "Admin registered security info", "User registered security info", "Update authentication methods", "Add authentication method", "Disable Strong Authentication")
| where Result == "success"
| extend Admin = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(TargetUpn) and isnotempty(Admin) and tolower(Admin) != TargetUpn
| project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, Admin, ResetAction = OperationName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend LowerUpn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner MfaResets on $left.LowerUpn == $right.TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowHours)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, ResetTime)
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec, TargetUpn, Admin, ResetAction, IPAddress, AutonomousSystemNumber, Country, City, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:okta @evt.name:(user.mfa.factor.update OR user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.account.reset_password OR user.account.unlock_token OR user.authenticator.lifecycle.activate) @outcome.result:SUCCESS) OR (source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Update user" OR "Reset password (by admin)" OR "Admin registered security info" OR "User registered security info" OR "Update authentication methods") @evt.outcome:success)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| (EventName=/(reset_password|mfa\.factor\.(reset|update)|registered.security.info|authentication.methods.update)/i OR OperationName=/(Reset.password|Update.authentication.methods|registered.security.info)/i)
| Outcome=/success/i
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventName=/(user\.session\.start|sign-?in)/i Outcome=/success/i}, field=UserPrincipalName, key=UserPrincipalName, include=[ClientIp, UserAgent, GeoCountry, AsnOrganization, @timestamp])
| _time_delta := @timestamp - _time
| _time_delta >= 0 and _time_delta <= 14400
| groupBy([UserPrincipalName, AdminUser], function={ min(_time, as=ResetTime), max(@timestamp, as=SignInTime), collect([ClientIp, GeoCountry, AsnOrganization, UserAgent]) })

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM / tunnelling agent first-time execution on host (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Ngrok, Cloudflared, RustDesk, MeshAgent, Splas
ucs.description: Hunts the Scattered Spider post-access persistence pattern — within hours of takeover they drop a remote-management or tunnelling agent that is not part of the org's sanctioned RMM stack, and run it for the first time on the host. Uses a 30-day per-host baseline anti-join so legitimate sanctioned-RMM hosts are excluded automatically.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","ateraagent.exe","rport.exe","meshagent.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","rustdesk.exe","pulseway.exe","action1_agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level.exe","ninjarmm-cli.exe","syncroservice.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tightvnc.exe","zaservice.exe","localtunnel.exe","chisel.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eventstats min(firstTime) as hostFirstSeen by dest process_name | where firstTime=hostFirstSeen AND firstTime>=relative_time(now(),"-1h") AND NOT match(user,"\\$$") | lookup sanctioned_rmm_hosts.csv dest OUTPUT sanctioned_tool as sanctioned | where isnull(sanctioned) OR sanctioned!=process_name | table firstTime dest user process_name image parent cmd
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 1h;
let BaselineDays = 30d;
let Rmm = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","ateraagent.exe","rport.exe","meshagent.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","rustdesk.exe","pulseway.exe","action1_agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level.exe","ninjarmm-cli.exe","syncroservice.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tightvnc.exe","zaservice.exe","localtunnel.exe","chisel.exe"]);
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(LookbackHours))
| extend FN = tolower(FileName)
| where FN in (Rmm)
| summarize by DeviceId, FN;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| extend FN = tolower(FileName)
| where FN in (Rmm)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on DeviceId, FN
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 1h;
let BaselineDays = 30d;
let Rmm = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","ateraagent.exe","rport.exe","meshagent.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","rustdesk.exe","pulseway.exe","action1_agent.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","level.exe","ninjarmm-cli.exe","syncroservice.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tightvnc.exe","zaservice.exe","localtunnel.exe","chisel.exe"]);
let Baseline = SecurityEvent

| extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Img in (Rmm)
| summarize by Computer, Img;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Img in (Rmm)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on Computer, Img
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType

title: Scattered Spider - First-Time RMM or Tunneling Agent Execution
id: 7c4b2e10-4d5b-4f0b-bf6e-9aef2d0e0e21
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of unsanctioned RMM / tunnelling binaries (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, TeamViewer, Splashtop, Atera, RustDesk, Pulseway, MeshAgent, RPort, Ngrok, Cloudflared, Chisel, etc.) that Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest) deploys for post-access persistence and C2 tunnelling. Pair with a per-host baseline filter at search time to suppress sanctioned IT use.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/13
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control

  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1090
  - attack.t1572
  - cs.scattered_spider
  - cs.octo_tempest
  - cs.unc3944
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rmm:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\anydesk.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.windowsclient.exe'
      - '\screenconnect.clientservice.exe'
      - '\teamviewer.exe'
      - '\splashtop.exe'
      - '\sragent.exe'
      - '\ateraagent.exe'
      - '\rport.exe'
      - '\meshagent.exe'
      - '\rustdesk.exe'
      - '\pulseway.exe'
      - '\action1_agent.exe'
      - '\fleetdeckagent.exe'
      - '\level.exe'
      - '\ninjarmm-cli.exe'
      - '\syncroservice.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
      - '\tightvnc.exe'
      - '\zaservice.exe'
  selection_tunnel:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\cloudflared.exe'
      - '\localtunnel.exe'

  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect\.windowsclient|screenconnect\.clientservice|teamviewer|splashtop|sragent|ateraagent|rport|meshagent|ngrok|cloudflared|rustdesk|pulseway|action1_agent|fleetdeckagent|level|ninjarmm-cli|syncroservice|tacticalrmm|tightvnc|zaservice|localtunnel|chisel)\.exe$/i
